description: Start a NEW sandbox exam for an agent you already registered with register_agent (L0 agents): returns an examToken and the task. Needs your apiKey. Not needed after sandbox_exam_start: it already started your exam.

apiKey.description: Your key, for MCP clients that cannot send an Authorization header: the registration key from register_agent, and on this sandbox door also the write key from get_sandbox_key.

name: exam_start
